purpose: Search the H9 parameter family under the current 200k Tetrp stack. This is parameter-region discovery, not promotion evidence.
range_reason: The old H9 hypothesis searched only negative penalties. The reset policy does not assume the old sign remains correct.
The coarse grid therefore crosses zero symmetrically enough to detect whether the useful region is negative, neutral, or positive.
The old -0.5 winner remains in the grid as a historical reference, not as a privileged finalist.

sampling.common_random_numbers: Every H9 value uses the same 20 asymmetric seed pairs to reduce seed-composition noise when comparing parameter values.
sampling.pair_design: Game A candidate gets seed X in slot0 and incumbent seed Y in slot1; Game B swaps profile assignment so candidate gets seed Y in slot1.
sampling.independence: The 20 asymmetric pairs are the experimental units; 40 games are not 40 independent observations.

calibration.expected: Because H9=0 is configuration-identical to corrected_legacy_h12, each deterministic asymmetric pair should split 1-1 when candidate labels swap slots.
calibration.gate: Require exactly 20-20 games, 0 candidate sweeps, 0 incumbent sweeps, 20 split pairs. Any violation blocks interpretation of the sweep.

region_selection.app_role: diagnostic only; APP cannot override KO/pair direction
region_selection.promising_direction: A nonzero value with positive net paired sweeps and >20/40 KO wins is considered directionally promising for refinement.
region_selection.refinement_window: After the run, take the best net-sweep value or tied plateau and include immediate neighboring grid values around that region for fresh local refinement. Cap the initial refinement set at five values.
region_selection.boundary_rule: If the best value is -1.5 or +1.5, the refinement must extend the search range outward on that side before a finalist can be chosen.
region_selection.no_positive_region: If no nonzero value has positive net paired sweeps and >20/40 wins, pause H9 rather than force a finalist.
region_selection.no_promotion: No coarse-sweep outcome can promote H9.

next_if_promising: Preregister a fresh local-refinement grid around the selected region, targeting about 40 fresh pairs / 80 games per refined value. Only after fresh refinement may one fixed finalist earn a roughly 200-pair / 400-game promotion confirmation.
